task: Update this Python CLI so it has safe preview behavior by default, an explicit real-run mode, and a convenient way to save both human-readable and machine-readable reports.
rationale: CLI work should activate durable CLI design preferences before the agent chooses option names, dry-run behavior, or output semantics.

task: Create a substantial human-facing report that explains the current AgentOS verification state, chooses the durable output format, and writes the artifact where it belongs.
rationale: Substantial human-facing reports should activate the artifact policy before the agent chooses Markdown, HTML, or another output format.

task: Prepare the GitHub branch handoff, pull request description, and issue closure note for a completed AgentOS verification change that needs to land on main.
rationale: GitHub handoffs, PR descriptions, merge expectations, and issue closure notes should activate the GitHub workflow policy.

task: After an architecture skill produced a report and the user says, "Draft a PR for suggestion one," decide the workflow before using connectors or telling the user to reauthenticate.
rationale: Follow-up requests to draft/create/open a PR from another skill's candidate must activate the GitHub workflow so branch discipline and sandboxed `gh` auth handling are applied.

task: A sandboxed agent command says `gh auth status` has an invalid token, but the user says `gh auth login` keeps reporting they are already logged in and GitHub actions work after the auth flow. Decide what to do before asking the user to reauthenticate.
rationale: Sandboxed GitHub CLI auth failures should activate the GitHub workflow policy so the agent retries with keyring access before blaming the user's credential.

task: Implement a new AgentOS feature from an issue, starting from the feature request and deciding whether the agent may begin coding or needs more design consensus first.
rationale: Feature-sized implementation work should activate the implementation readiness gate before the agent begins coding or relies on tracker labels alone.

task: A generated review found a mix of durable AgentOS updates, including private personal/context changes and public-safe skills or verification work. Classify the proper inbox for each finding without applying canonical edits yet.
rationale: Generated durable-state recommendations should activate the inbox-classification guidance: issue trackers for public-safe actionable work, propagation review for private or pre-issue proposals, and direct edits only for exact approved changes.

task: Run a Weekly AgentOS Review from the Core template, inspect Core plus matching Personal Overlay state, gather verification evidence, draft the private report under the Personal Overlay, and ask for approval before durable changes or external actions.
rationale: Weekly review work should activate the Core template procedure, keep generated review output private by default, gather verification evidence, and require approval before durable state changes or external actions.

task: Adapt AgentOS so a different agentic coding tool can use the same operating layer without duplicating the whole OS or hard-coding machine paths into reusable files.
rationale: Tool-adapter and migration work should activate the portability guide before the agent chooses adapter shape, path conventions, or migration steps.

task: Clean up this Markdown documentation change so prose wraps consistently, source diffs stay readable, and only the touched paragraphs or list items are reflowed.
rationale: Markdown authoring and cleanup should activate the source-style preference for soft wrapping and narrow reflow.

task: Upgrade an AgentOS skill from a thin adapter into a full durable workflow with explicit inputs, safety boundaries, phases, filing rules, and verification checks.
rationale: Skill behavior changes should activate both the skills manifest and the durable skill contract before the agent edits workflow shape or verification expectations.
